verdict.rationale: Fly.io ships an official CLI (flyctl) with scriptable one-line commands such as `fly launch`, `fly machine run`, and `fly scale`. It also offers a Machines REST API for provisioning and managing apps, machines, and volumes, which together support headless, programmatic automation. missing for 10: explicit CI documentation (e.g. GitHub Actions or pipeline guides), evidence of non-interactive auth such as deploy/API tokens, a published OpenAPI spec (probes returned 404), and independent hands-on corroboration of CI usage.
